newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Feedgrain buys 52,000 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: Korea Feedgrain buys 52,000 tonnes of corn.

text.p: Korea Feedgrain Purchase Committee (KFPC) bought 52,000 tonnes of corn on Tuesday at $136.95 per tonnes, C&F, traders said on Wednesday.

Traders said Romak sold the corn through private negotiation. Arrival was set for June 30 to the western port of Inchon. They said the corn may be sourced from Argentina since its planned shipment is during the main Argentine export season.
The KFPC consists of feed mill companies including Shindongbang Corp and Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd which had previously bought their corn needs through the Korea Feed Association.
